definition: The E063 two-port hidden response normal form is exactly a positive scalar multiple of the recovered chirality-seed mirror contrast. The E086 probe c_* is therefore the canonical nontrivial seed-contrast mode in this representation.
math: D_chi=[[1,-1],[-1,1]]; spec(D_chi)={0,2}; c_*=(1,-1)^T; D_chi c_*=2 c_*; DeltaLambda_H=w_eff D_chi, w_eff>0.
